name: Type87 Arv
operating_principle: The Type 87 is a wheeled armoured vehicle that uses a 6x6 drivetrain and a two-man turret to provide reconnaissance and patrol capabilities. It is equipped with a 25mm KBA cannon and a 7.62mm machine gun.

components.description: The main structural body of the vehicle, providing protection from small arms fire and shell splinters.
A two-man turret that houses the main armament, a 25mm KBA cannon, and a 7.62mm machine gun.
A 6x6 drivetrain that provides mobility and traction for the vehicle.
An Isuzu 10PBI ten-cylinder water-cooled diesel engine that powers the vehicle.
A system of springs and shock absorbers that provides a smooth ride and stability for the vehicle.
A compartment that houses the crew and provides storage for equipment and supplies.
A system of periscopes and vision blocks that provides visibility for the crew.
Additional armour plating that provides extra protection for the vehicle.
